channel.title: The Syrian Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Syrian Observer (syrianobserver.com)

item.title: President Sharaa: The 2026 Budget Rises to $10.5 Billion as National GDP Forecasts Approach $65 Billion - The Syrian Observer
item.description: President Sharaa announced an increase in the minimum wage following recommendations from the Ministry of Finance and in consideration of prevailing poverty indicators, al-Thawra reports.

item.title: A Clash of Ordinances: Damascus Governorate Moves to Contain the Fallout Over Alcohol Regulations - The Syrian Observer
item.description: The Governorate described the resolution as administrative rather than ideological, presenting it as a continuation of an established legal framework

item.title: Civil Defiance in Damascus: Activists Gather in Bab Touma to Oppose Discriminatory Zoning Mandates - The Syrian Observer
item.description: Prominent lawyer Michel Shammas challenged the Governorate’s interpretation, asserting that Resolution 311 exceeds the bounds of executive authority, Syria TV writes.

item.title: The Impediments to Repatriation: Why Syria’s Intellectual Capital Remains in European Exile - The Syrian Observer
item.description: European governments may express a desire to accelerate repatriation, yet the overwhelming majority of skilled professionals harbour no immediate intention of returning voluntarily, Abdallah Al-Turkmani argues in Syria TV.

item.title: Security Tensions and Diplomatic Overtures Following the Incident in Ayn al-Arab - The Syrian Observer
item.description: Minister Hamo presented a vision of collective stability, noting that the individual who lowered the flag and those who disparage the Kurdish component are driven by the same corrosive impulse to sow discord.

item.title: A Door Left Ajar: How Washington Reopened the World to Syria’s Weapons Engineers - The Syrian Observer
item.description: The recent American decision to lift sanctions on 266 employees of the Scientific Studies and Research Center has raised serious concerns, al-Masdar writes.

item.title: Washington Convenes High-Level Dialogue on Syrian Energy Restoration and Investment - The Syrian Observer
item.description: The summit arrives at a moment of profound transition as Syria moves from the long shadow of conflict toward the early contours of structural stability, Ultra Syria writes.

item.title: Selective Law and Constitutional Neglect in the Administrative Transition - The Syrian Observer
item.description: Anas Hamdoun, a renowned critic of the transitional government in Damascus, criticized Social Affairs and Labour Minister Hind Kabawat for, in his view, reinforcing sectarian logic rather than challenging it.

item.title: The Ebbing Tide of Syrian Governmental Popularity - The Syrian Observer
item.description: The cooling of public enthusiasm stems above all from the speed with which expectations had risen, Hussam Jazmati writes for Syria TV.

item.title: A Presidential Fiscal Proclamation Tested by Economic Reality - The Syrian Observer
item.description: In a televised address following Eid al-Fitr prayers at the Presidential Palace in Damascus, Syria’s transitional leader, Ahmed al-Sharaa, unveiled what he described as a transformative fiscal blueprint for 2026.
